name: io.github.equilibrium-team/tweekit
title: TweekIT MCP Server
description: Preflight and convert 450+ file types for AI via TweekIT MCP & SDK (Cloud CGN or On-Prem Miner).

environmentVariables.name: TWEEKIT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: TweekIT API key issued from the TweekIT account portal (optional when targeting a loopback NOAUTH Miner Renderery via TWEEKIT_MINER_NOAUTH=1).

environmentVariables.name: TWEEKIT_API_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: API secret paired with TWEEKIT_API_KEY for authenticated conversions (optional when TWEEKIT_MINER_NOAUTH=1 is enabled on loopback).

environmentVariables.name: TWEEKIT_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional TweekIT API or On-Premises Miner Renderery URL (e.g., http://127.0.0.1:16377/api/image/ for localhost processing).

environmentVariables.name: TWEEKIT_MINER_LOCAL
environmentVariables.description: Optional flag ('1' or '0'). When '1', defaults API routing to the local On-Premises Miner Renderery (http://127.0.0.1:16377/api/image/).

environmentVariables.name: TWEEKIT_LOCAL_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional flag ('1' or '0'). When '1', enforces localhost/on-prem Miner Renderery routing and blocks third-party cloud egress.

environmentVariables.name: TWEEKIT_MINER_NOAUTH
environmentVariables.description: Optional flag ('1' or '0'). When '1', allows loopback Miner Renderery requests without cloud API credentials.

environmentVariables.name: TWEEKIT_ONPREM_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated list of trusted private LAN Miner Renderery hostnames or IPs permitted under TWEEKIT_LOCAL_ONLY=1.

environmentVariables.name: TWEEKIT_REQUIRE_LOCAL_MINER_FOR_FILES
environmentVariables.description: Optional flag ('1' or '0'). When '1', convert_file refuses to upload local files unless routed to a local or on-prem Miner Renderery.

headers.name: ApiKey
headers.description: TweekIT API key issued from the TweekIT account portal.

headers.name: ApiSecret
headers.description: API secret paired with the ApiKey for authenticated conversions.
